**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is trying to organize notes from recent networking events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered to help create a spreadsheet to organize networking event notes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant suggested a template for a "Networking Event Follow-up Tracker" with three sheets: Event Summary, People Met, and Follow-up Log.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided details for the Event Summary sheet, including fields for Event Name, Date, Location, Number of attendees, and Brief notes about the event.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided details for the People Met sheet, including columns for Name, Title/Company, Contact Info, Conversation Notes, Follow-up Action, Follow-up Deadline, Status, and optional columns for Industry/Category, Next Steps, and Tags/Keywords.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided details for the Follow-up Log sheet, including columns for Date, Name, Follow-up Action, and Response.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested using filters and sorting functions to track follow-ups, prioritize actions, and analyze progress.  
[USER] User requested to add a column to track the event type (e.g., conference, networking reception, meetup).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant agreed and suggested adding a new column to the People Met sheet for Event Type.  
[USER] User mentioned they met someone from Google at a marketing conference at the Hilton Hotel but forgot to note down the date, recalling it was around mid-February.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested adding a note in the Event Summary sheet with the details remembered and proposed adding a Date Range column for incomplete date information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for managing incomplete data, including consistency in recording and creating a "To-Research" list.  
[USER] User recalled the exact date of the marketing conference at the Hilton Hotel as February 10th and mentioned meeting Rachel from Google to discuss intent-based marketing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested updating the Event Summary sheet with the correct date and details about Rachel.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided an example of the updated Event Summary sheet with the correct date and details about Rachel.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided an example of the updated People Met sheet with Rachel's information, including a follow-up action and deadline.  
[USER] User requested to add a column to track the current status of each follow-up action (e.g., "pending", "completed", or "rejected").  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant agreed and suggested adding a Follow-up Status column to the People Met sheet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided categories for follow-up status: Pending, Completed, Rejected
